quantity_inventory.definition: Measured mass of the same person; weight is used colloquially by the source, not gravitational force.
Measured standing body height of the same person.
Body mass divided by squared standing height; not a body-fat fraction or BMI-for-age percentile.
Independently specified active-drug mass per body mass for one administration, already normalized to kg/kg.
Patient body mass on the independently specified dosing-weight basis; measured total mass only when that is the prescribed basis.
Active-drug mass corresponding to the specified coefficient and body mass for one administration.
Final infusion-fluid volume assigned to the complete interval at the stated delivery boundary.
Continuous elapsed duration of the same complete interval, in seconds; not accumulated daily operation or a count.
Volume per elapsed time averaged over the same complete interval; a constant target only under the declared constant-delivery profile.
Final fluid volume assigned to the infusion interval at the drip-chamber calibration basis.
Number of drops per fluid volume for the selected set and applicable fluid conditions; not a universal drop volume.
Continuous elapsed infusion duration in seconds over the same volume interval.
Real-valued mean drops per second corresponding to the specified volume, factor and interval.
Actual measured total body mass of this patient, used only when that is the independently authorized prescription basis.
Numerical chronological age in years as required by this historical calibration; not a duration in seconds.
Actual measured patient body mass; no ideal/adjusted mass substitution in this profile.
Serum creatinine mass per serum volume, matched to this assessment and documented assay calibration.
Indicator selecting the source's stated sex branch: 0 male, 1 female. It is a historical formula category, not an inference about gender or contemporary individual physiology.
Historical algebraic estimate of creatinine clearance, as an effective serum volume per time; not measured GFR and not BSA-indexed.
Creatinine mass per urine volume in a representative mixed aliquot of the complete timed specimen.
Entire urine volume from the same complete collection, not the small aliquot submitted for assay.
Representative serum creatinine mass concentration matched to the collection interval.
Actual continuous elapsed collection duration in seconds; source application is a complete nominal 24-hour collection with actual times recorded.
Measurement-derived effective serum volume cleared of creatinine per time over the collection interval; not BSA-adjusted.
Active-drug mass already specified for this single administration on the same labeled active-moiety basis as H.
Mass of the specified active drug contained in stock reference volume Q; not total formulation mass.
Final liquid formulation volume containing labeled active-drug mass H.
Unrounded liquid volume containing D under the specified stock mass-to-volume proportion.
GFR estimate per actual area unit, not the unconverted numerical value printed for a standard 1.73 m^2 body surface.
Supplied body surface area for the same adult and assessment, in square metres, with method/provenance specified.
Absolute glomerular filtration rate estimate for the individual, without reference-area indexing; distinct from creatinine clearance.
Measured circumference of the waist at the explicitly declared anatomical landmark and assessment condition.
Measured standing height of the same person at the same assessment.
Dimensionless ratio of measured waist circumference to standing height.
Measured waist circumference at the declared protocol landmark for this assessment.
Measured hip circumference at the declared protocol landmark for the same assessment.
Dimensionless waist circumference divided by hip circumference.
Actual measured human body mass for the same assessment as linear body extent.
Measured standing height or infant recumbent length, with method explicitly distinguished by context.
Body mass divided by the cube of the declared linear body extent, using the SI numerical convention.
Mass of the identified constituent contained in the entire specified formulation sample, not total mixture mass.
Total final volume of the same homogeneous liquid formulation, including constituent and carrier effects.
Mass of one identified constituent divided by total final solution volume.
Mass concentration of the identified conserved solute in the starting aliquot.
Positive volume of the initial homogeneous aliquot actually transferred into the dilution.
Total final diluted formulation volume after mixing, supplied independently.
Mass concentration of the same conserved solute in the final homogeneous mixture.
Mass concentration of the selected active constituent in the infused homogeneous solution.
Nonnegative fluid volume delivered per elapsed time at the same boundary and interval.
Mass of the selected active constituent delivered per elapsed time at the specified boundary.
Actual body mass at the identified postpartum assessment following the specified childbirth event.
Actual measured body mass at the declared pre-pregnancy or early-pregnancy baseline for the same pregnancy.
Signed postpartum mass difference relative to the specified baseline.
Actual measured usual/baseline body mass at the declared reference assessment.
Actual measured body mass at the current assessment for the same person.
Signed fraction of baseline body mass by which current mass is lower; negative values denote gain.
Actual measured body mass at the initial assessment.
Actual measured body mass at the later assessment.
Continuous elapsed duration between these two mass assessments.
Signed endpoint body-mass change per elapsed time over the stated interval.
Nitrogen mass contained in serum urea per serum volume; conventional BUN analyte basis.
Serum creatinine mass per serum volume at the same assessment.
Dimensionless conventional BUN nitrogen-mass to creatinine-mass concentration ratio.
Already authorized active-drug mass per patient body surface area for one administration, normalized to kg/m^2.
Independently supplied BSA of the same patient, with measurement/estimation method and assessment state documented.
Active-drug mass corresponding to the authorized per-area amount and supplied patient area for one administration.
Total measured circumference at the declared mid-upper-arm site.
Measured doubled skin/fat fold thickness at the matching upper-arm site, treated as the diameter decrement under the source geometric approximation.
Calculated inner muscle-core boundary circumference, enclosing central bone, under the circular/uniform-rim geometric model.

attempted_deferred.title: Fractional sodium excretion from paired measurements
attempted_deferred.reason: Direct original study inspected: Schreuder et al., Nephron2017;136:221–225, DOI10.1159/000468547, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5516416/. Equation1 rendering labels urinary sodium nmol/L versus serum mmol/L while separately normalizing creatinine units. Do not silently correct that unit ambiguity. Study cohort is ages4–18, GFR>60 mL/min/1.73m^2,761 reliable collections; paper explicitly warns against a universal diagnostic cutoff. A faithful future record needs an unambiguous primary equation/unit source and a precise distinction between a creatinine-clearance-referenced ratio and a true filtered-sodium fraction. Device-manual alternative https://fcc.report/FCC-ID/ZLZ-EPM/4297304.pdf was discovery only; direct retrieval403. No candidate, diagnostic cutoff or approximate correction is returned.
